entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Hi, um, David. I think I need to return something? I got this helmet a few days ago, and I'm just... I'm a bit lost with the whole process.
I can certainly help you look into a return. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, a preference, I guess. The website made the color look different. It's not what I expected at all. The box is still here, I think it's a box unopened. I haven't even taken it out. Can't you just help me? This is all so confusing.
Of course, I can absolutely help you with that. It's no problem at all. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear, especially when it comes to safety and feeling good in what you wear.
So... I can return it? Just because of the color?

Yes, definitely. I see here that your helmet was delivered just six days ago. For items like helmets and jerseys, VeloFit has a 90-day return policy, so you are well within the timeframe for a full refund.
Oh, thank goodness. I was so worried I was stuck with it. That's a relief.

Not at all. I'm emailing you a prepaid return shipping label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the original packaging, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Once our warehouse receives it, we'll process your refund back to your original payment method.
Wow, that's much easier than I thought. Thank you so much, David. You've been a real help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
